intro: Today's developments highlight the rapid evolution of AI infrastructure and new hardware prototypes. We are seeing a mix of breakthrough research benchmarks and practical tool integrations across industries.

must_know.title: AI and compute
must_know.summary: New analysis indicates that compute usage for large AI training runs is doubling every 3.4 months, significantly faster than the 2-year cycle of Moore's Law.
must_know.why_it_matters: The rapid acceleration of compute requirements highlights the resource-intensive nature of current frontier AI development.

must_know.title: Meta is making a standalone Muse AI gadget
must_know.summary: Meta unveiled a prototype standalone AI device named 'Muse Charm' during the Meta Connect presentation.
must_know.why_it_matters: Marks a potential strategic move by Meta toward dedicated AI hardware beyond standard wearables or software apps.

must_know.title: Introducing MentalHealthBench
must_know.summary: OpenAI has introduced MentalHealthBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the safety and helpfulness of AI in mental health-related conversations.
must_know.why_it_matters: Establishes a standardized framework for testing AI capabilities in sensitive, high-stakes human interaction domains.

foundation-models.title: Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech says hello
foundation-models.summary: Google DeepMind has introduced the Gemini 3.8 text-to-speech model.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: Expands Google's generative audio capabilities within the Gemini product ecosystem.

hardware.title: The Download: India’s smart glasses menace and AI’s trillion-dollar gamble
hardware.summary: Recent reports highlight the privacy implications of smart glasses following incidents in India, alongside broader discussions on the economic sustainability of AI.
hardware.why_it_matters: Raises ongoing concerns regarding the intersection of wearable technology and public privacy.

tools.title: Harvey turns legal context into stronger drafts with GPT-6 Astra
tools.summary: Legal technology firm Harvey is integrating GPT-6 Astra to improve the structure and context-awareness of legal document drafting.
tools.why_it_matters: Illustrates the application of frontier models in specialized professional workflows to improve efficiency.

tools.title: Ringg’s AI agents resolve up to 65% of customer calls with OpenAI
tools.summary: Ringg has deployed GPT-5.6 to automate customer service interactions, achieving a 65% resolution rate at a 90% lower cost compared to previous versions.
tools.why_it_matters: Highlights the economic impact of scaling AI-driven customer support solutions.

policy.title: Sam Altman’s remarks at the United Nations Security Council
policy.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the United Nations Security Council to discuss AI safety, the necessity of human oversight, and international collaboration.
policy.why_it_matters: High-level engagement between AI leaders and global policy bodies is increasingly critical for governance frameworks.
